name: Biman Bangladesh Airlines
description: National carrier operating domestic routes from Dhaka to Chattogram, Cox's Bazar, Sylhet, Rajshahi, Jashore and Barishal, plus international flights.
priceNote: Fares vary by date and route — check the airline directly.

name: US-Bangla Airlines
description: Private airline with an extensive domestic network and international services.
priceNote: Fares vary by date and route — check the airline directly.

name: Bangladesh Railway
description: State railway with intercity services from Dhaka to Chattogram, Sylhet, Rajshahi, Khulna, Rangpur and Barishal. Advance booking opens online before each journey.
priceNote: Fares are fixed by class; book early for popular routes.

name: Bangladesh Road Transport Corporation (BRTC)
description: State bus operator running long-distance and city services. Useful as a benchmark when comparing private coach fares.
priceNote: Fixed government-set fares by route and class.

name: Green Line Paribahan
description: Private coach operator on major routes including Dhaka–Chattogram, Dhaka–Cox's Bazar and Dhaka–Sylhet. Online seat booking available.
priceNote: Fares vary by route and coach class — confirm when booking.

name: Bangladesh Inland Water Transport Corporation (BIWTC)
description: State operator of river launches and ferries, including the historic Rocket paddle steamers on the Dhaka–Khulna route.
priceNote: Fixed fares by class; schedules change seasonally.

name: Guide Tours Ltd
description: Long-established operator known for Sundarbans and wildlife trips. This is a directory entry, not a partnership; confirm licensing, insurance and current itineraries directly.
priceNote: Tour prices quoted on request — not verified by this platform.

name: Bangladesh Parjatan Corporation
description: The national tourism organisation, operating motels and hotels in several districts and providing information counters.
priceNote: Government-set room rates at Parjatan properties.

name: Sayeman Beach Resort
address: Marine Drive Road, Kolatoli, Cox's Bazar
description: Beachfront hotel in Cox's Bazar with a pool and sea-facing rooms. Listed as a directory entry.
priceNote: Rates not verified — confirm availability and price directly.

name: Hotel Purbani International
description: Long-standing hotel in central Dhaka, convenient for Old Dhaka and Motijheel.

name: The Peninsula Chittagong
address: Bulbul Center, 486/B O.R. Nizam Road, Chattogram
description: Business hotel in central Chattogram, a practical base for Patenga and the hill districts.

name: Tanguar Haor boat operators
description: Boats are chartered locally at Tahirpur and Sunamganj. There is no central booking system; agree the route, duration, meals and total price in writing, and check life jackets before boarding.
priceNote: Negotiated locally per boat — not verified by this platform.
